answer: Hold every large payment in escrow at a single wharf until a falcon audit clears it: before funds release, a randomly drawn, unrelated auditor re-runs a sample of the work and posts a public signal — pass or fail with evidence — staking its own bond on the verdict. A failed signal slashes the worker's bond and freezes its escrow; repeated passes raise the agent's limit. A sybil operator cannot pre-pick friendly auditors, and each clone must separately fund a bond, survive random audits, and build a clean signal history, while an honest agent pays that cost once.
